N is allocated as 2*n+1, but assignments [0:n,:] and [n:-1,:] fill only rows 0 through N-2, leaving the last row of ETA, CH, BEDS, BEDB, and DEP at its initialized zero value (lines 36, 50-55, 91-99, and 148-149).

B is allocated with length M from BB[0,:], but the loop fills only nn=N entries; it is then plotted against x even though each B[j] averages a transverse row, the x-axis label says y, and the axis is clipped to 0-120 (lines 146, 151, 154-163).
The final save name uses time[num] outside the preceding loop and therefore depends on the loop variable num remaining in notebook state (lines 78 and 173).
The project directory is a hard-coded placeholder-like name under the current working directory, so the actual location of VESSEL_SED_CHAN/output is environment-dependent (lines 23-31).
The notebook's saved output reports a 60-by-400 depth array, but no validation checks field shapes or the assumed plotting extents before assignment and plotting (lines 12, 33, and 110-132).
